title: Strip footing with a large eccentricity: maximum soil pressure

rubric.text: The response should notice that the eccentricity of 0.4 m is larger than B/6 = 0.333 m, so the trapezoidal formula does not apply and part of the footing lifts off.

expert_notes: e = 120/300 = 0.4 m > B/6. Contact 3(B/2 - e) = 1.8 m; q max = 2P/(3(B/2 - e)) = 600/1.8 = 333.3 kPa. The trapezoid formula would give 375 and -75 kPa, which is wrong.
